name: Six Senses Krabey Island
short_description: A private-island luxury resort near Sihanoukville with 40 pool villas across a 30-acre jungle island, reached by a short speedboat transfer.
ai_summary: Six Senses Krabey Island occupies its own 13-hectare (32-acre) private island in the Gulf of Thailand, about 11 km from Sihanoukville International Airport and reached via a short speedboat transfer from a private jetty. Opened in 2019, the resort has 40 pool villas set among jungle and coastline, two restaurants, a spa with seven treatment areas, and a marine conservation program guests can join. TripAdvisor ranks it #4 of 137 hotels in Sihanoukville at 4 of 5 from 222 reviews, and it holds 2 Michelin Keys, with guest and press coverage consistently praising the villas, service, dining, and barefoot-luxury atmosphere.

core_facts.address: Koh Krabey Island, Ream Commune, Prey Nob, Preah Sihanouk Province 18000, Cambodia
core_facts.elite_notes: Six Senses Krabey Island is one of a handful of Six Senses properties that does not currently participate in IHG One Rewards -- IHG's own booking flow for this hotel states 'IHG One Rewards is not applicable at this Six Senses hotel at this time,' so members cannot earn or redeem points or elite benefits here, unlike most other Six Senses resorts.

pros: An entire private 13-hectare (32-acre) island with 40 pool villas set among jungle and coastline
2 Michelin Keys, reflecting its positioning among Cambodia's top luxury resorts
Reached via an 11 km transfer from Sihanoukville International Airport plus a short speedboat crossing
Active marine conservation program with coral gardens guests can visit
Consistently praised service, dining, and spa across guest and press reviews
cons: Does not currently participate in IHG One Rewards, so elite members earn no points or benefits here
Remote private-island access (speedboat transfer) makes it a deliberate, planned trip rather than a casual stop
research_highlights: Guest reviews and press coverage repeatedly single out the villas, staff service, and dining quality
The resort's marine conservation and sustainability programming is a recurring highlight in independent reviews
Holds 2 Michelin Keys and a #4-of-137 TripAdvisor ranking in Sihanoukville
research_watchouts: IHG One Rewards is explicitly not applicable at this property, unlike most other Six Senses hotels
Access requires a private-jetty speedboat transfer, adding logistics and cost versus a mainland hotel

faqs.question: Can I earn or use IHG One Rewards points at Six Senses Krabey Island?
faqs.answer: No -- Six Senses Krabey Island is one of the small number of Six Senses properties that does not participate in IHG One Rewards. IHG's own booking system for this hotel states the program is not applicable here, so members cannot earn points, redeem points, or receive elite benefits during a stay.

faqs.question: How do you get to Six Senses Krabey Island?
faqs.answer: The resort sits on its own private island about 11 km from Sihanoukville International Airport. Guests are typically transferred by road to a private jetty on the mainland, then taken across by a short speedboat crossing to the 13-hectare island, where all 40 villas include a private pool.
